in_marathi.name: Rohid
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohid हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rohid is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', which means 'brave' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Rohini is a star in the constellation of Taurus, and is also identified with the goddess of the same name, who is considered the mother of the moon.
